title: Terraform Guardian: control-plane provisioner with preflight fingerprinting and staged rollback
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a reusable Terraform module and orchestration harness (terraform-guardian) that provisions Redwood Private EKS control planes inside customer VPCs. Key capabilities: preflight fingerprinting to detect drift and incompatible terraform state, modular seed manifest application (YAML templating + k8s apply controller), automated staged canary upgrades for control-plane components, machine-readable health attestations (JSON) emitted after provisioning, idempotent apply semantics, and rollback hooks that integrate with our control-plane operator. Deliverables include module code, integration tests, CI pipeline changes, a small operator shim to consume health reports, and documentation for on-prem and VPC install flows.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module can create/update control-plane resources declaratively and is idempotent across repeated applies
Preflight fingerprint step detects mismatched cluster topology or provider drift and surfaces a human-readable report
Provisioner emits a standardized health attestation JSON artifact to S3 (or local path for on-prem) summarizing API server, etcd, cert rotation, and node readiness
Canary upgrade flow supports staged subset upgrades with automated health gates and automatic rollback on gate failure
Module has integration tests in CI that run a lightweight happy-path and simulated failure cutover
Operator shim consumes attestation and can trigger automated remediation runbooks defined in the project docs
tasks: Design preflight fingerprint schema and decide canonical fields to validate (topology, kms keys, subnet alignment, iam roles)
Implement terraform module with clear inputs/outputs and minimal provider assumptions
Add modular seed manifest application path (templating + retry/backoff) and make it optional via variable
Implement health attestation generator as a small Go utility invoked at the end of apply/upgrade
Wire canary upgrade logic: config flags, target subset selection, health gate evaluation, rollback hook
Add unit and integration tests, including failure injection for upgrade rollback
Create CI job and small demo runbook + Confluence page
Security review and KMS integration validation
